Subject: Onsite demo request — week of Jan 26/27

Hi Kimberly / Marcus,

Thanks again for the time on the call today. BrightCore would like to do an in-person evaluation of Redwood at your Novato HQ the week of Jan 26. We're targeting a 2.5-3 hour block to run through an architecture-level demo, hands-on queries against our red-team prompts, and a brief Q&A.

Can you confirm availability on Jan 26 or Jan 27 (morning preferred)? We will have 3 people on our side: me (Aisha Gupta), Ethan Morales (platform lead), and one security engineer (TBD).

Also — we need to complete an NDA before the visit. Happy to sign whatever you need.

Thanks,
Aisha

Please complete the attached visitor NDA before arrival so our security team can pre-clear your guests. Also reply with the full names and driver license numbers (or government ID types) for badge printing, and any dietary restrictions.

- Send attendee list + IDs so we can submit for visitor badges.
